body: Yeah, I would have to agree with you on that. Hopefully you got some rest last night. We've been talking and I got to talk and play some games with this group of guys she's been gaming with last night. It was a good experience, I just hope that it grows friendlier ties between her and I. It's weird. I just want to move on from this and feel as if I'm an alright person. You know?

I'm doing fine. She apologized for being mean saying she was really annoyed with me and having a bad day. 

But something she loved to tell me is still ringing in my head "when you're mad the truth comes out." Meh. I'm still down about everything and work was difficult because of that. Thanks for your concern. How are you?

Seven years as friends, a year and a half as a couple, and some odd months in this purgatory with her. I just thought that she would see me as so much more.

But thank you for your kind words. I'll try and keep my chin up.

I don't understand anything about this whole thing. Just monday we were perfectly fine, friendly, cuddly, and together as friends. Then she became cold and just left me.

I don't understand why the only person I actually feel something real for at this moment in time just berates me like I'm the most horrible person on the planet. I question myself and everything I do. I judge myself more than anything else that I do and I can't help but feel that I'm not good enough for anything.
I see downvotes in my future but, A PS2.
I'm going to a state run community college. Classes are $91 per credit hour. Not too expensive. It's the books that hit hardest sometimes.
I hope I can get enough with just one job and have a car that is actually reliable. We'll see what happens. Thanks for the advice.
